simple.summary: מַבְלִיגִית (mablîygîyth) means desistance (or rather desolation) First listed occurrence: Jer 8 18.

definitions.full: H4010. mabligith [ מַבְלִיגִית ] noun feminine smiling, cheerfulness , source of brightening — יָגוֺן עֲלֵי מַבְלִיגִיתִי Jer 8:18 a source of brightening to me in sorrow ; but text dubious compare VB Che.
